description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'AccessStrategy' within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. It provides a base implementation for access control strategies, including methods for managing parameters, match criteria, and data retrieval related to maintenance entities. The class utilizes a MaintenanceService and includes methods for formatting values and assembling access records.

classes.name: AccessStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a template for access control strategies within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the access strategy with entity class name and configuration info.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Abstract method to determine access for a given employee number.

methods.name: getMaintenanceService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and retrieves the MaintenanceService instance.

methods.name: getMatchByValues
methods.description: Generates match key-value pairs based on employee number.

methods.name: getEntityRecords
methods.description: Retrieves entity data linked to an employee number and table.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Formats a value using a specified formatting class.

methods.name: addRecordsToArray
methods.description: Builds an array of data from an access entity based on stored parameters.
